description: Find exact substrings (env vars, symbols, error codes) in an indexed local codebase.

exclude.description: Gitignore-style glob patterns; matching files are removed (optional)

include.description: Gitignore-style glob patterns; only matching files are searched (optional)

limit.description: Cap returned hits (optional; omit for all)

repo.description: Local directory path to index (optional; defaults to the working directory)

name: locate
